name: VitaJ2ME
author: MetalSyntax
description: VitaJ2ME runs Java ME (J2ME / MIDP 2.0, CLDC 1.1) games natively on the PlayStation Vita. It is a port of PSPKVM (Sun's phoneME Feature VM, as adapted for the PSP) from MIPS to ARMv7, with a new native front end: a game library, per-game settings, a virtual keypad, touch support and an in-game menu.
